data.gender_notes: Lajlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who comes in the night, derived from the Arabic root 'lajala', meaning 'to come'. In Islamic tradition, Lajlah is associated with peace, calmness, and serenity, making it an ideal name for a baby girl. The name Lajlah carries the meaning “Night comer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lajlah usually hope their child will grow to embody night comer and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Lajlah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night comer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lajlah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
